name: Lingword
author: Jonathan Derque
description: A Wordle-style word game: guess the hidden five-letter English word in six tries, with colored hints and an on-screen keyboard.

descriptions.en: A Wordle-style word game: guess the hidden five-letter English word in six tries, with colored hints and an on-screen keyboard.
descriptions.it: Un gioco di parole in stile Wordle: indovina la parola inglese segreta di cinque lettere in sei tentativi, con indizi colorati e tastiera sullo schermo.
